components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;background:var(--brand,#1b725c);color:#fff;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:42px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms,color 140ms}.ds-primary:hover{background:#105337}.ds-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-field input,.ds-nav button{transition:none;transform:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#283b43);border:1px solid var(--line,#e2e8ed);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:42px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#edf3ed}.ds-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-field input,.ds-nav button{transition:none;transform:none}}

components.name: Input
components.description: Visible project field label and form control.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink,#283b43)}.ds-field input{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#283b43);background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--line,#e2e8ed);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;caret-color:var(--brand,#1b725c);transition:border-color 140ms}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-field input,.ds-nav button{transition:none;transform:none}}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Forest rail with selected fill and logical-edge mint marker.
components.css: .ds-nav{background:var(--sidebar,#173b36);padding:16px;display:grid;gap:6px;max-width:238px}.ds-nav button{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;position:relative;font-size:13px;background:transparent;color:#c5ded3;border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 13px;min-height:45px;text-align:start;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms,color 140ms}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#234b41;color:#fff}.ds-nav .ds-current,.ds-nav .ds-current:hover{background:#2d594b;color:#ddf7eb}.ds-nav .ds-current:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset-inline-start:0;top:50%;margin-top:-9px;height:18px;width:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent,#a9dfc8)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-field input,.ds-nav button{transition:none;transform:none}}

narrative.overview:
Deep forest navigation frames a cool, lightly tinted workspace. White working panels, clear borders, compact type and restrained status color make project records easy to scan. The dashboard adopts the user's chosen reference hierarchy through original implementation; no template assets or code are part of this system.

The current system is extracted from the final workspace redesign block in the stylesheet and its implemented components. Source code is the visual authority; there is no approved image composition. Bilingual behavior, explicit data provenance and visible feedback belong to the working interface.
keyCharacteristics: Orderly forest navigation and cool working surfaces.
Compact bilingual typography with readable data and tabular figures.
Border-led panels, written states and record-derived charts.
Local, purposeful motion with reduced-motion feedback.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with a written label; preserve explicit selected navigation contrast.

rules.name: The Record Meaning Rule
rules.body: Chart color identifies recorded project value and manually marked paid value by project creation month; it never implies payment receipt dates or bank activity.

rules.name: The Numeric Alignment Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for amounts, totals, and metrics, retaining readable currency labels in both directions.

rules.name: The Direction Rule
rules.body: Use logical spacing and alignment so Arabic RTL and English LTR preserve the same hierarchy.

dos: Do preserve Arabic-first RTL and complete English layouts.
Do use borders, alignment, and spacing to group operational information.
Do keep written status labels beside color cues.
Do retain local-storage, sample-data and draft cues where their state applies.
Do make motion explain a local state change and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce ornamental dashboard shadows or marketing hero treatments.
Don't replace labeled sample data with implied real customer or revenue claims.
Don't imply receipt dates, bank activity or payment collection from a manually marked paid field.
Don't shrink dashboard secondary labels below 12px to fit content.
